description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultMongoDbConfig class, verifying its immutability, equals/hashCode methods, string representation, and configuration value correctness in various scenarios.

classes.name: DefaultMongoDbConfigTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior and configuration values of DefaultMongoDbConfig class.

methods.name: initMongoDbConfig
methods.description: Initializes the rawMongoDbConfig field by parsing the mongodb_test.conf resource.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultMongoDbConfig and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to test the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations for DefaultMongoDbConfig.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toString() representation of DefaultMongoDbConfig includes specific class and field names.

methods.name: defaultMongodbConfigContainsExactlyValuesOfResourceConfigFile
methods.description: Verifies that the deserialized config matches expected values from the resource file, including nested configs.

methods.name: defaultMongodbConfigContainsExactlyFallBackValuesIfEmptyResourceConfigFile
methods.description: Verifies that default/fallback values are used when config is minimally specified or missing.
